NOW AVAILABLE – 2015 MERCEDES-BENZ E 350 4MATIC – ONLY 96K MILES – 2 OWNERS – LONG-TERM COLORADO HISTORY – RIDGELINE RECONDITIONED
96,739 Miles | Stock #J1068
VIN: WDDHF8JBXFB145193
3.5L V6 | 302 HP | 7-Speed Automatic | 4MATIC All-Wheel Drive
If you're looking for a proper Mercedes-Benz sedan without stepping into newer-car pricing, this 2015 Mercedes-Benz E 350 4MATIC is a very strong example.
The W212-generation E-Class is a great combination of traditional Mercedes comfort, solid build quality, strong performance and modern technology without feeling overly complicated.
This one has only 96,739 miles, just two previous owners, long-term Colorado ownership, regular documented oil changes and 19 CARFAX service records.
Even better, the second owner kept it for approximately 8 years and 6 months, averaging only about 8,489 miles per year.
And after we purchased it, we put another $1,369.42 into Ridgeline inspection, maintenance and reconditioning before offering it for sale.
WHY THE E 350 4MATIC IS SUCH A GOOD MERCEDES
This is one of our favorite drivetrain combinations from this generation of E-Class.
Under the hood is Mercedes-Benz's naturally aspirated 3.5-liter V6 producing 302 horsepower, paired with a 7-speed automatic transmission and Mercedes-Benz 4MATIC all-wheel drive. Our shop records confirm the 276.952 3.5L V6 and 302-horsepower rating.
One of the things we particularly like about the E 350 is that Mercedes didn't need turbochargers to make it powerful.
You get a smooth, responsive V6 with more than enough power for highway merging and Colorado mountain driving, combined with the security of AWD.
It's a great combination for someone who wants a luxury sedan that can genuinely be used year-round in Colorado.
THE W212 E-CLASS
The W212 is an important generation of the Mercedes-Benz E-Class.
It still has that substantial, solid Mercedes feel that longtime Mercedes owners appreciate. The doors feel substantial, the cabin is quiet, the seats are designed for long-distance comfort, and the suspension strikes a great balance between handling and highway comfort.
It's the kind of car that makes a two-hour highway drive feel easy.
And with 4MATIC AWD, you don't have to park it when Colorado weather changes.
ONLY 96,739 MILES
Mileage is another big reason we liked this car.
At just 96,739 miles, this E 350 hasn't even crossed 100K yet.
More importantly, the mileage is backed up by a good ownership history.
The first owner leased the vehicle and averaged approximately 9,546 miles per year.
The second owner purchased it in 2018 and kept it for approximately 8½ years, averaging only about 8,489 miles per year.
Long-term ownership like that is something we really like to see when we're considering an older European luxury vehicle for our inventory.
PREVIOUSLY OFFERED AS A MERCEDES-BENZ CERTIFIED PRE-OWNED VEHICLE
There's another interesting part of this Mercedes' history.
In 2017, Mercedes-Benz of Littleton offered this E 350 for sale as a Mercedes-Benz Certified Pre-Owned vehicle.
At that time, the vehicle received:
- Pre-delivery inspection
- Alignment
- Four-wheel alignment
- Tire inspection
- Tire rotation
- Vehicle preparation
The Certified Pre-Owned coverage is obviously long expired, but it's still a nice part of the vehicle's history.
19 SERVICE RECORDS AND REGULAR OIL CHANGES
CARFAX shows 19 service-history records and specifically notes that the vehicle has a history of regular oil changes.
There are also some substantial maintenance records.
At approximately 28,267 miles, Mercedes-Benz of Littleton performed the 30,000-mile service.
At 41,408 miles, the 40,000-mile service included:
- Battery replacement
- Brake fluid flush
- Electrical system check
- Engine check
- Ignition coil replacement
- Spark plug replacement
- Wiper replacement
Then, at 62,689 miles, Mercedes-Benz of Littleton performed another substantial service that included:
- Air filter replacement
- Brake inspection
- Fuel system service
- Oil and filter change
- Rear brake pads
- Spark plugs
- Transmission filter replacement
- Transmission fluid change
- Tire rotation
- Wiper replacement
We particularly like seeing the transmission fluid and filter service documented on a Mercedes approaching 100K miles.
RECENT MERCEDES SPECIALIST SERVICE
The maintenance didn't stop when the vehicle got older.
In 2025, Hoover Mercedes in Parker serviced the vehicle.
At 79,616 miles, CARFAX documents:
- Battery replacement
- Brake inspection
- Ignition coil replacement
- Oil and filter change
A few months later, Hoover Mercedes checked the engine/powertrain computer and replaced another ignition coil.
Most recently, at 93,063 miles in May 2026, Hoover Mercedes again serviced the vehicle, checked the brakes and cooling system, replaced a headlight and changed the oil and filter.
It now has only 96,739 miles.
THEN IT CAME TO RIDGELINE
This is where our process starts.
We don't simply buy a car, make sure there aren't warning lights on the dashboard, wash it and put it online.
We brought this E 350 into Ridgeline Automotive, our full-service repair facility and NAPA Auto Care Center, and performed our complete inspection and road-test process.
Our current work order totals $1,369.42 in inspection, maintenance and reconditioning.
That work includes:
- Four brand-new Kenda Vezda UHP A/S2 tires
- Mount and balance all four tires
- New front brake pads
- New front brake rotors
- Replacement right outer tail lamp assembly
- BG EPR Engine Performance Restoration
- BG MOA Advanced Formula
- 5W-40 Full Synthetic European-spec oil
- New Hengst oil filter
- Complete multipoint safety inspection
- Full module scan
- Road test
FOUR BRAND-NEW TIRES
This is a good example of how our inspection process works.
The existing tires weren't all completely bald. One still measured 7/32‘.
But the four tires measured:
Right Front: 7/32‘
Left Front: 5/32‘
Left Rear: 4/32‘
Right Rear: 2/32‘
That's not the tire situation we want on a Mercedes-Benz 4MATIC we're putting on our lot.
So rather than replacing one tire or trying to squeeze a few more miles out of the existing set, we replaced all four.
The E 350 now has four brand-new Kenda Vezda UHP A/S2 tires, mounted and balanced.
That's a substantial immediate expense the next owner doesn't have to worry about.
NEW FRONT BRAKES
Our road test also found that the front brake rotors were warped, and our inspection measured the front brake pads at only 3mm.
Again, we didn't leave that for the next owner.
We installed:
New NAPA front brake pads
Two new front brake rotors
So the next owner starts out with four new tires and new front brakes.
PREMIUM RIDGELINE ENGINE OIL SERVICE
We also gave the 3.5L V6 more than a basic used-car-lot oil change.
Our service included:
BG EPR Engine Performance Restoration
BG MOA Advanced Formula
6.9 quarts of 5W-40 Full Synthetic European oil
New Hengst engine oil filter
We use BG EPR as part of the service before draining the old engine oil. The old oil is then drained, a quality Hengst filter is installed, and the engine is filled with fresh European-spec full synthetic oil and BG MOA.
It's more expensive than simply draining the oil and filling the engine with bulk oil.
But on a Mercedes we're putting our name behind, we'd rather do it this way.
FULL RIDGELINE INSPECTION
Our inspection wasn't limited to tires, brakes and an oil change.
We checked:
- Battery and battery cables
- Full vehicle module scan
- Power doors
- Horn
- Windshield
- Wipers and washers
- Instruments and warning indicators
- Engine startup and idle
- Road-test drivability
- Seat belts
- Exterior lighting
- HVAC operation
- Fluid levels

description:
This 2016 Audi S4 in Monsoon Gray Metallic represents a refined choice for those seeking performance and sophistication in a sedan designed for driving enthusiasts.

- 3.0L V6 TFSI Supercharged engine with 7-Speed Automatic S tronic transmission
- Audi quattro all-wheel drive with rear sports differential
- Technology Package with HDD Navigation, Voice Control, and Audi Connect Online Services
- Bang & Olufsen Premium Sound System with 14 speakers and 505 watts
- High Gloss Black Package with 19-inch titanium 5-spoke wheels and all-weather summer performance tires
- Audi Side Assist lane change assistant with visual mirror warnings
- Power moonroof
- Black fine Nappa leather seat trim with 3-step heated S sport-contoured front seats
- Parking System with rearview camera and rear acoustic sensors
- Xenon Plus high-intensity discharge headlights with headlight cleaning
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control with rear air conditioning
- Premium leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls
- Panoramic interior with HomeLink garage door transmitter

Built on the platform of a performance-oriented sedan, this S4 combines capability with comfort. The supercharged V6 engine delivers responsive power through the S tronic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive system, engineered for confident handling on various road conditions. The rear sports differential enhances cornering dynamics while maintaining stability. The 19-inch Titanium wheels wrapped in summer performance tires contribute to the vehicle's poised stance and grip.

Inside, the cabin reflects Audi's attention to detail. The black fine Nappa leather seats provide both support and comfort, enhanced by three-stage heating for cold weather. The Technology Package puts comprehensive controls at your fingertips—navigation, climate management, and connectivity functions operate through the intuitive center console interface. The Bang & Olufsen sound system delivers quality audio whether you're streaming via Bluetooth or enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio with four years included.

Safety and convenience features are integrated throughout. The Parking System assists with rear approaches, while Audi Side Assist monitors traffic during lane changes. Power windows, heated mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror add layers of practical functionality. Electronic stability control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain composure through varied driving situations.

The exterior styling speaks to the S4's purposeful design. Beyond the sleek lines of this gray sedan, the High Gloss Black Package adds visual distinction with its darkened grille treatment and body-color mirrors. Xenon Plus headlights offer improved visibility and a contemporary appearance, while rear fog lights enhance visibility in poor conditions.

This S4 is offered with our 5-Day Return and 30-Day Exchange program, giving you confidence in your purchase decision. We invite you to experience this sedan firsthand and discover how German engineering and thoughtful design come together in a vehicle built for those who value both performance and refinement.
